description: Checks a VXLScript game the way the VXLVERSE editor does: it builds, someone is in it, it holds nothing unsafe or personal, and the player can reach the win. Returns the errors to fix (the first one first), or ok with a direct link that opens the game in the editor, how big the game is (a short one comes with what to add), and what it read: each described person's looks with the words it could not show, what each World became, and notes on what does not match or does nothing in the story. Stores nothing; call it again after each fix.

lang.description: The user's language for the site around the game. Default en.

script.description: The whole game as plain VXLScript, in English, starting with its Title: line.

name: check_game
title: Check the game
